_comment: Model artifacts the app will eventually carry, with their provenance.
Licenses and sources were verified in docs/ml-models.md; the sha256
a pinned block exists only after bytes were fetched and verified;
unfetched entries stay null because an invented checksum is worse
than none. fetch.py pins the hash on the first successful fetch,
and verifies against the pin ever after — the pinning commit is the

beatnet_model_2.purpose: BeatNet fold checkpoint 2. The three published models hold out GTZAN, Ballroom and Rock Corpus respectively; all three are unseen on RWC, which is in none of BeatNet's five training corpora. Fetched to test whether a better or averaged activation is worth pursuing before any model is built — see docs/ml-models.md.
